effects.trigger: passing out of sight of the doors
constraints: the person enters through the main entrance

evidence.locator: A person entering SCP-3008 through the main entrance and then passing out of sight of the doors will find themselves translocated to SCP-3008-1.

constraints: measurements are inconclusive as to whether the space is infinite

evidence.locator: SCP-3008-1 is a space resembling the inside of an IKEA furniture store, extending far beyond the limits of what could physically be contained within the dimensions of the retail unit.

constraints: during day they react violently if attacked

evidence.locator: During the "night" instances of SCP-3008-2 will become violent towards all other lifeforms within SCP-3008-1.
SCP-3008-1 is known to have one or more exits located within, though these exits do not appear to have a fixed position, making it difficult to leave SCP-3008-1 once inside.
